verse.verse_1: WHEN THE SUN is folded up,
verse.verse_2: The stars turn dim and scatter,
verse.verse_4: The ten-month pregnant female camels are abandoned,
verse.verse_5: The wild beasts stampede on the run,
verse.verse_6: When the oceans surge and swell,
verse.verse_7: When souls are reunited (with the bodies)
verse.verse_8: And the little girl buried alive is asked
verse.verse_9: For what crime she was put to death;
verse.verse_10: When the ledgers are laid open,
verse.verse_11: The curtain drawn back from the skies,
verse.verse_14: (Then) every soul will know what it had prepared (for itself).
verse.verse_15: So, I call the receding stars to witness,
verse.verse_19: That this is indeed the word of an honoured Messenger,
verse.verse_20: Full of power, well-established (in position) with the Lord and Master of the Throne,
verse.verse_21: Obeyed and worthy there of trust.
verse.verse_23: He had surely seen Him on the clear horizon.
verse.verse_24: He is not chary of making public what is unknown.
verse.verse_25: This is not the utterance of an accursed devil.
verse.verse_27: This is a reminder for all the peoples of the world,
verse.verse_28: For those of you who desire to walk the path that is straight,
verse.verse_29: Though you cannot desire except as God will, the Lord of all the worlds.
